question: 'File Name: mainnet/contracts/market/v0-4-market.clar -> Scope: Critical. PRICED TWICE IN ONE TRANSACTION - the seam nobody modelled. Enumerate every transaction in which two price resolutions of the SAME asset can disagree, determine which one the safety check used and which one moved the money, and prove the gap with a single simnet transaction that asserts the two resolved values differ. Impact: name it as direct theft, permanent freezing, or protocol insolvency.'
